title: Study on the Mechanism of Diosgenin Targeting STAT3 to Inhibit Colon Cancer Proliferation and Migration.
authors: Lai, Zonglang; Wang, Huaibi; Tang, Xiaohui; Zhang, Liufan; Wang, Tiantian; Cheng, Jun
one_liner_zh: 该文研究薯蓣皂苷靶向STAT3抑制结肠癌增殖迁移，仅用分子对接预测蛋白靶点，核心是药物-蛋白作用而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: To elucidate regulatory effects and molecular mechanisms of diosgenin on colon cancer, this study administered diosgenin at concentrations of 10 (low), 50 (medium), and 100 mumol/L (high concentration group) at the cell level, respectively. EdU, colony formation, and Transwell assays were implemented to determine SW480 cellular proliferation and migration. Assays of flow cytometry and TUNEL were employed to estimate cell apoptosis. Additionally, nude mouse tumorigenesis assay was used to further verify the regulatory function of diosgenin on colon cancer. The target protein of diosgenin was predicted via molecular docking. The results showed that all three concentrations of diosgenin could reduce colon cancer cellular proliferation and migration, and after diosgenin treatment, colon cancer cellular apoptosis was markedly increased, and the 100 mumol/L diosgenin group produced the most satisfactory inhibition on colon cancer cell proliferation. Ki67 expression was markedly reduced whereas those of Bax and caspase3 were greatly increased after diosgenin treatment. The nude mouse tumorigenesis assay indicated that the parameters of tumorous volume and mass of diosgenin treatment group were greatly decreased as compared to control, and as the concentration of diosgenin increased, the inhibitory effect was more significant. Molecular docking indicated that STAT3 served as a target protein of diosgenin. Moreover, after diosgenin treatment on colon cancer cells, the STAT3 expression was markedly reduced. The STAT3 overexpression would counteract the inhibitory effect of 50 mumol/L diosgenin in both suppressing colon cancer cellular proliferation and migration and promoting apoptosis. Taken together, all our outcomes demonstrated the diosgenin effects in not only inhibiting colon cancer cellular proliferation and migration but also promoting cancerous cellular apoptosis. Diosgenin is a regulatory player in targeting and regulating STAT3.
abstract_zh: 为阐明薯蓣皂苷元对结肠癌的调控作用及分子机制，本研究在细胞水平分别给予10（低）、50（中）和100 μmol/L（高浓度组）的薯蓣皂苷元处理。采用EdU、集落形成和Transwell实验检测SW480细胞增殖与迁移。通过流式细胞术和TUNEL实验评估细胞凋亡。此外，使用裸鼠成瘤实验进一步验证薯蓣皂苷元对结肠癌的调控功能。通过分子对接预测薯蓣皂苷元的靶蛋白。结果显示，三种浓度的薯蓣皂苷元均能降低结肠癌细胞的增殖和迁移，且薯蓣皂苷元处理后，结肠癌细胞凋亡显著增加，其中100 μmol/L薯蓣皂苷元组对结肠癌细胞增殖的抑制作用最为理想。薯蓣皂苷元处理后，Ki67表达显著降低，而Bax和caspase3的表达显著升高。裸鼠成瘤实验表明，与对照组相比，薯蓣皂苷元处理组的肿瘤体积和质量参数显著降低，且随着薯蓣皂苷元浓度的增加，抑制作用更为显著。分子对接表明STAT3是薯蓣皂苷元的靶蛋白。此外，薯蓣皂苷元处理结肠癌细胞后，STAT3表达显著降低。STAT3过表达会抵消50 μmol/L薯蓣皂苷元在抑制结肠癌细胞增殖和迁移及促进凋亡方面的抑制作用。综上所述，所有结果表明薯蓣皂苷元不仅能抑制结肠癌细胞增殖和迁移，还能促进癌细胞凋亡。薯蓣皂苷元是靶向调控STAT3的调节因子。
